purpose: Validated V620 TP2 + original packed MTP3 + K5/V4 KV with replicated std routers; set runtime_env before importing EXL3 and pass settings explicitly (not auto-loaded).

batch1.evidence: K5/V4 and replicated router: 8K+256 AR/MTP repeated jobs; 32K+256 JA/code finite with fixed4.

energy_policy: User-selected energy saving; not a response to cooling or 400W capability limits.
caveats: Speculative verification still uses the unchanged target model; acceptance and speed depend on prompt/sampling.
Default host memory reserve guard stays enabled; ZFS ARC can trigger it despite reclaimable cache. Diagnostic guard overrides are recorded per run.
Use the bare HSA library name in LD_PRELOAD on this container; the absolute .so.1 spelling also loaded the Torch-bundled HSA runtime. Loaded paths are audited by tp_run.

EXL3_NGRAM_MLOCK=1 requires sufficient per-process RLIMIT_MEMLOCK; the library fails explicitly instead of silently allowing paging. The artifact runner sets only its own benchmark process limit; OS/ARC/swap settings are unchanged.

mlock.scope: Engram CPU table ranges only; no copy or CUDA host registration; limit applied only to benchmark parent and inherited children
